venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Tuesday 9/8 (MOD Jk).** Beat target: net $2,237 vs $2,023 target (+11%); food $539; event $0; comps $37.20 (1.7%); 49 guests / $45.67 check avg. Back for Bingo Tuesday after the holiday — small turnout but new Bingo host Maddy is getting comfortable. Opener handled the cleaning duties usually done Monday; barback knocked out prep for the week. Quiet night overall. Reminder to keep an eye out for refreshers on garnishes and an updated mise en place. Kitchen: smooth — if an item can't go out to standard, 86 it until it can. 86 pickles, 86 wings. No maintenance needs; no-shows not charged. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Tuesday 9/8 (MOD MD / Chef JMS).** Missed target: net $888 vs $1,437 target (−38%); food $143; comps $84.95 (9.6% — bingo comp, DNL, F&F, Neuhoff resident); 32 guests / $27.76 check avg. Sleepy Tuesday — everyone recovering from the long weekend. Fewer bingo attendees than usual and shorter stays; ~$330 net by 7pm, nearly cleared out after bingo, 5–8 guests until the final hour when industry guests and a couple of nightcaps joined. Kitchen: John Michael held it down. Maintenance: well 1 soda tap handle. Low: lassi mix. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: met Amanda (Van Leeuwen GM) at last call; Graham and Ian from Optimist back in. Entered by BC.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Tuesday 9/8 (AM: Carey / PM: Maggie H).** Missed target: net $6,715.90 vs $8,187 target (−18%). DC/AM $933.16; D&C (PM) $5,782.60; no Garden/6A; food $1,682.55; no events (event fields NA); comps $87.98 (1.3%); 171 guests (Tock) / ~$39.27 check avg. (Typed date 8/8 — matched by day of week and post time.) AM: sweet cruise — fresh black and peach iced tea, fresh cold brew, double batches of caramel and mocha, deep-cleaned bottles, confirmed Rishi order; 86 coconut milk. PM: cut Paige early; JP learned '9p comes for us all' but is picking up SevenRooms quickly with good consideration for server/bar seating. Kitchen: no big food pop, steady 7–8:15 then fizzled; cleaning projects done; question on ranch for sides (guests ask); low: honey butter, crudo sliced scallops, chicken thighs; 911: scallop add, creamed spinach, succotash, ranch; 86: tart shells, tarragon jam, scallop add, succotash. Break make-up complete; no-shows not charged; no incidents. Favorite moment: celebrating Kim's one year. Entered by MJH.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Tuesday 9/8 (MOD Kyler & Steves).** Missed target: net $3,448 vs $3,631 target (−5%); food $392; beverage $3,056; no events; comps $105.04 (3.0%); 93 guests (SevenRooms) / $37 check avg; 7 solos, 0 large parties, 8 investor cocktails. Top sellers: Rosalie, Shinebox, Paper Wasp. Very slow-drinking crowd on a post–Labor Day hangover night; never a standout wave, mostly two-tops wandering in and settling the room at ~2/3 capacity, shifting to post-Broadway nightcaps and dates after 10pm. Visitors from Seattle excited to see the original; investors/members in solo, incl. Buck Wanner and Kenan Anderson; Liz from Williams & Graham (Denver); regular Tim celebrating a promotion; 5 birthdays and 1 anniversary. No no-shows (one guest accidentally booked DCLA). Menu count 18; no breakage. Maintenance: downstairs prep paper-towel dispenser malfunctioning. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Tuesday 9/8 (MOD Julian, Josh & Saleh).** Missed target: net $3,383 vs $4,164 target (−19%); Marquee $3,383 (food $758), Standing Room closed ($0); no events; comps $269.70 (8.0% — a couple of food items sent back: crudo milk too thick; a couple of cocktails guests didn't like); 84 guests / $40.28 check avg. Chill, slow-paced night — weather and the long weekend a factor; guests lingered but kept the vibe going. Members hung out; several first-timers had a blast. Gracy tasted food and cocktails ahead of her floor debut; Julian's first FOH manager shift. Kitchen: a few crudos sent back — need to see why; otherwise strong. Maintenance: buckling floor tiles in the 20s. 86 grenadine. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: Mitchell's 10-second bartending crash course for Alissa. Entered by Julian Catano.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.weather: Hot to start but cooled off
venues.narrative: **DC — Tuesday 9/8 (MOD Marcus).** Beat target: net $6,634.70 incl. events vs $3,650 target (+82%). Marquee bar $2,188.06, Garden $0 (garden event), food $315.80, event sales $4,446.64; 'Total Net Sales Including Events' was left blank ('not sure how to find this') — figure derived as Marquee + Garden + Event Sales, consistent with how the venue reports it on other nights. Comps $58.20 (community member/investor $48.20, gift $10); event void $1,117. 86 guests (32 walk-in / 14 resy / 40 event); reported guest avg $42.32. (Typed date 9/9 — matched by day of week/post time.) Light night for the Marquee: biggest pop at opening ~5:30, steady trickle of two-tops until 8pm, real slowdown by 9:30 with a handful left; host cut ~9, started breaking down a well at 10:30. Kitchen did a great job with event plating — Rasaan and James making quite the team. Went well: communication, connection. Do better: resetting to zero. Injury/incident reported: Yes (no detail given). Maintenance: kitchen waterproof flooring. No-shows not charged. Favorite moment: a table talking about the history of the Nick & Nora glass. Entered by Marcus.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Tuesday 9/8 (AM: Sam & Shannon / PM: Justin & Marcus).** Beat target: net $4,228 vs $3,309 target (+28%). Municipal Bar AM $1,311 (71 guests) / PM $2,805 (65 guests); Sun Club $95; Hot Eye $0; food $2,227; no events; comps $158.60 (3.8%); 136 guests (OpenTable AM+PM) / ~$31.09 check avg. AM: solid brunch — Eva and Sam held it down with 3–4 tables at all times, busiest 11–12 with two good-sized food tours; busier than expected post-holiday. PM: slow start to happy hour foreshadowed the evening; a few back-to-back reservations early; two-server floor, no server assistant needed; Jason stayed to help close; small IRD rush. Estella Reyes trained with Tia (ABK, food knowledge); Aleeza's first training day with Emma as first-time trainer. Sun Club dead and windy until ~5pm, then 2–3 pool guests to close. Kitchen: slow, no lows/86s; trainee Ish did a great job on the line day one. No incidents; no maintenance needs. Favorite moment: Sierra's repeat guests ecstatic to be served by her again. Entered by Justin.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Tuesday 9/8 (MOD Curtis Hayes / Julian Abel).** Beat target: net $11,022 vs $10,000 target (+10%); food $1,447; comps $547 (5.0% — shifties $99, service recovery $65; overall a low comp night); 212 guests / $52.47 check avg. Good Tuesday — everyone got breaks, family meal was delicious, a few folks pulled together to fill schedule gaps, and Curtis got sent home early. Most guests out before midnight. Need to tell guests arriving 10pm+ that there's a limited late food menu — one late 10:30 reservation was disappointed they couldn't order the full menu (left happy, but should be noted on the menu). Kitchen: everything tasty, a few long tickets. Maintenance: Negroni Verde / fee-foam drinks. 86: Stepping Razor, Negroni Verde, Uwaji Gimlet (ingredients land tomorrow). No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: spicy family meal. Entered by Julian Abel.
